about: s05: Word windows: one question, one person. Cue times are seconds from the shot's start. 'island' lines: text (app copy), optional sub, kind plain|shimmer, in type|cut, or hide. The island keeps its last line across shots until a shot changes it. s05 is the lead's worked example of motion.js: words cut in on the tick, the window cuts open between two words, the second window lands to full frame and becomes s06.
